about_the_game:
Starforged Legacy is a fast-paced, roguelike auto-shooter where you’ll pilot a starcraft through the war-torn remnants of humanity’s intergalactic colonies. Command unique ships, augment salvaged weaponry to create a fleet-leveling arsenal, and navigate through a perilous, ever-changing galaxy teeming with challenges as you carve your legacy amongst the stars!

Features

  • Intense Bullet-Hell Combat - Engage in high-octane battles against swarms of enemy ships and massive bosses. Evade enemy bombardments with unique movement abilities and return fire manually or automatically.

  • Customizable Ship and Crew - Unlock, pilot, and master 16 unique ships, each with distinct starting armaments and combat styles. Recruit and assign crew members to your ship for additional benefits.

  • Weapon and Ship Augmentation - Discover 6 unique weapons and more than 115 augments to enhance your ship’s combat and survival capabilities.

  • Galactic Navigation - Navigate sectors with treacherous conditions, including asteroid fields, solar flares, and high-alert zones, to complete missions that are no less dangerous. Choose your path wisely.

  • Dynamic Encounters - Investigate or desperately try to ignore the pulse emanating from the void. Comply with a mandatory cargo investigation or bribe the enforcers. Your choices will determine your survival.

  • Meta Progression - Exchange salvaged resources for permanent upgrades, new starcraft, crew members, and other options to aid you in future expeditions.

Choose from 16 unique starcraft across three classes: nimble frigates, versatile cruisers, and titanic battleships. All ships—through their special augments, weapons, and movement abilities—lend themselves to unique playstyles and combat specializations, such as the agile, radiation-spewing burst-drive “Stormbolt” frigate or the titanic “Dominance” battleship, boasting a micro-warp drive capable of teleporting short distances.

Carefully select your crew of naval officers, engineers, and pilots to receive additional modifications and augmentations to your ship!

Discover over 115 weapon and ship augments to create game-breaking synergies and redefine your strategy each expedition!

Transform your hull with augments like Pulsing Plating, enabling your ship to release a forceful burst of energy when sustaining damage, or deploy Proximity Mines to eliminate pursuing fighters.

Enhance your combat prowess with Smart Rounds, ammunition that ricochets between targets, or Nuclear Warheads, radioactive payloads that leave a damaging, lingering cloud in their wake.

Your Starmap is a web of opportunity and peril. Choose your path through hazardous sectors and encounter space stations in need of reinforcements, inhabited planets under siege from The Observers, and derelict ships with priceless data in need of salvaging.

Completing these missions, as well as random secondary objectives, will earn you rewards crucial to your survival: weaponry, augmentations, credits, and even crew members!

Finding a merchant can allow you to spend your credits on upgrades and much-needed repairs. Responding to a distress beacon may lead you to become the savior of a group of stranded scientists—or place you at the mercy of something far worse!

Death is not the end. Battlefield wreckage, recovered data, and alien technologies salvaged from your failed expeditions can be exchanged for powerful, permanent upgrades to your arsenal! Unlock fleet-wide stat boosts, new ships with unique combat specializations, additional crew members, and ship customizations!

Early Development Disclaimer

Starforged Legacy is currently in early development. The features we currently have and those planned for the future may change as we gather feedback from our community. You can expect to see these changes reflected here as they occur.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400/AMD Ryzen 3 1300X or Equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 or Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400/AMD Ryzen 5 5600 or Equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060 or Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system.
